title: The way of the Church (Redemptor Hominis 14)
hook: the human person is the way for the Church
tomorrow: a tired fisherman is told to try again, farther out. why?

segments.voice: Yesterday: witnesses first, a life heard before a word. And this week's lines, all in a row: one family, free to seek, rightly called brothers, where you are, sent by nature, witnesses first.
screen: `WITNESSES FIRST.` → `A WEEK OF THE COUNCIL, OUT IN THE WORLD.`

segments.voice: Every big organization has a road map: the five-year plan, the strategy slides, the growth chart with the arrow going up. Pope John Paul II, in an encyclical called Redemptor Hominis, named the road a whole church has to travel. It isn't on any chart. It's a person.
screen: `THE FIVE-YEAR PLAN.` → `THE ARROW GOING UP.` → `THE ROAD IS A PERSON.`

segments.voice: Paragraph fourteen opens with a refusal: the Church cannot abandon the human person. Then the image. The human person, John Paul II writes, is the primary route the Church must travel in carrying out its mission, a way traced out by Christ himself. And which person? Not humanity in the abstract. The real, concrete, historical person: each one, in the unrepeatable reality of who they are, with their mind and will, their conscience and heart. He leans on a line from last week, Gaudium et Spes 22: by becoming human, Christ united himself in some way with every person. If God took that road to each person, the Church can't take a shortcut around anyone. And it gathers these two weeks into one picture: a kitchen table, a call to love, a conscience, a family of peoples, a freedom no one may force, siblings across churches, a bakery shift, a sending, a witness. Every one of them ran through a person.
screen: `THE CHURCH CANNOT ABANDON THE PERSON.` · `THE PRIMARY ROUTE IS A PERSON.` · `EACH ONE, UNREPEATABLE.` · `NO SHORTCUT AROUND ANYONE.` · then, large: `THE PERSON IS THE WAY.`

segments.voice: Say aloud, slowly, the name of one person you'll see tomorrow, the way you'd want your own name said. Then add one thing about them nobody else has: a laugh, a habit, a worry they carry. Rest there, with one unrepeatable person in mind.
The way of the Church. Redemptor Hominis 14: the human person, each one, is the road the Church must travel.
screen: `THE WAY OF THE CHURCH — today's word`.

segments.voice: Hold onto this: the person is the way, with no shortcut around anyone. Two weeks of the council's pages, done.

screen: `DAY 1596 COUNTS.` → `TOMORROW: WHY TRY AGAIN, FARTHER OUT?`

Redemptor Hominis.meaning: John Paul II's letter on Christ and the person; Latin: Redeemer of man

encyclical.meaning: a teaching letter from a pope to the whole Church

John Paul II.meaning: the pope who wrote Redemptor Hominis

Gaudium et Spes.meaning: Vatican II's document on the Church in the modern world

sources.work: Second Vatican Council, Gaudium et Spes
